text: Ibath and Ibcan are minor Irish heroes. They descend from the hero Iarbanel. They are called Nemedians. This name follows Iarbanel 's father, their grandfather Nemed.
objective: Document the minor Irish heroes Ibath and Ibcan.
key_results: Note the name Nemedian from their grandfather Nemed.
